verdict.rationale: Temporal's server source is public on GitHub at temporalio/temporal, and its self-hosting guide describes it as "open source infrastructure software", so the source can be read under an open license. However, the pack never names the license or its terms. Missing for 10: explicit license identification (e.g., the license name and file), independent corroboration of the license terms, and evidence that the full product (SDKs, Web UI, CLI) is under the same open license.
